intro: Alina makes rest feel richer. With its soft upholstered headboard, finish, and hidden storage, it gives you space to stretch out, stay organized, and wake in a calmer, clutter-free room.

features.title: Upholstered headboard for cozy evenings
features.text: Relax against the cushioned headboard, upholstered in synthetic leather, making bedtime reading, conversations, or unwinding more comfortable.

features.title: Hidden storage for daily ease
features.text: A mix of box storage with handles and a smooth pull-out drawer keeps bedding, quilts, and daily essentials neatly tucked away.

features.title: Strong engineered wood frame
features.text: Built from 17 mm particle board, including headboard, side panels, and base partitions, offering lasting strength for everyday use.

features.title: Easy transport and assembly
features.text: Knockdown construction arrives flat-packed, so shifting homes or refreshing layouts is simple, without sacrificing strength.

features.title: Walnut finish with timeless warmth
features.text: The rich walnut shade adds natural warmth to your bedroom, pairing seamlessly with varied décor styles and color palettes.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
